newsitem.title: USA: PECO seeks power generation supply licenses.
newsitem.headline: PECO seeks power generation supply licenses.

text.p: PECO Energy Co said Monday it requested approval from the Pennsylvania Public Utility Commission (PUC) to be an electric generation supplier in the state's retail pilot programs set to begin by January 1, 1998.
PECO said it has two applications for review by the PUC.

After filing an application to market power as PECO Energy on June 30, PECO said it filed an application today for Horizon Energy, a wholly owned subsidiary that was established in 1995, and is currently providing non-regulated natural gas marketing services including participation in natural gas pilots in New Jersey and Maryland.

The Pennsylvania legislature adopted the Electric Generation Customer Choice and Competition Act last year. Under the Act, all Pennsylvania consumers will be able to select an electric generation supplier by January 1, 2001.
Currently, customers must purchase electric generation from their local utility.
